instruction.goal:
Generate a short outreach email from Alex, Head of Partnerships at DataSync, to someone whose company recently launched a new product.

Congratulate them on the launch. Keep it brief and genuine. Mention how DataSync's integration platform could complement their new product. Add a CTA to schedule a 15-minute call.

Keep it under 100 words and under 500 characters.

Generate a subject line under 50 characters.

Plain text only. No links. No emojis. No exclamation marks.
Keep sentences short and concise. Friendly and professional tone.
Do not mention their job title. Do not reference competitors.
instruction.evaluationGuideline: Email should feel human, warm, and not salesy. Avoid corporate buzzwords.
